finding: We tested whether guarding against uncertain cue reliability improves storage beyond the policy chosen for two-thirds reliability, and found no reduction in worst expected regret in these 420 problems. It improves on fixed storage in 147. Independent rational reconstruction and both full replays verify this constructed-method result; forecast accuracy and process correspondence remain unestablished.
